apps.name: NES
apps.sub: Play NES games from your files
apps.description: A real NES emulator that runs in a window. It ships with a handwritten test ROM so you can see it is alive; drop in a cartridge image from your own files and it plays. Once installed it offers to become the default app for .nes files.
highlights: Offers to open .nes files for you

apps.name: Snake
apps.description: Grid-based snake with a score, a speed curve, and swipe controls for phones. Arrow keys or WASD on a keyboard. No scoreboard, no accounts, no pop-ups.

apps.name: Calculator
apps.description: A pocket calculator: four functions, percentages, sign flip, and a memory of the last result. Deliberately dull — a calculator that wants to be clever is a calculator that lies.
highlights: Works with no network at all
